content.short: Spaceseven is a multi-chain NFT platform that enables users to create, sell, and buy NFTs.
content.description: Spaceseven enables you to turn digital content into NFTs on the blockchain, including books, images, videos, musical tracks, and other complex digital files. You describe your item and publish it on public blockchains like Concordium or Ethereum to bring it into the public market. The Spaceseven marketplace supports bidding and purchasing, and purchased items stay in your wallet as on-chain assets. These items reside on the blockchain for secure ownership and transferability across compatible wallets.
